nodes.description: public constant string name = "PHT" token name
public constant string symbol = "PHT" token symbol
public constant uint32 decimals = 0, used as exponent in supply calculation
public uint256 total token supply, written in constructor and read by totalSupply()
mapping(address => uint256) internal ledger of token balances
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) internal ERC20 allowance ledger
constructor pharmatrix(uint256 initialSupply): mints the whole supply to msg.sender with an unchecked multiplication
totalSupply() view returning the totalSupply state variable
transfer(address _to, uint256 _value): moves tokens from msg.sender using SafeMath sub/add
transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value): spends allowance of msg.sender and moves balances
approve(address _spender, uint256 _value): directly overwrites the allowance value
allowance(address _owner, address _spender) view reading the allowed mapping
increaseApproval(address _spender, uint _addedValue): adds to the existing allowance with SafeMath.add
decreaseApproval(address _spender, uint _subtractedValue): subtracts from allowance using a local oldValue branch
getBalance(address _a) internal constant returning balances[_a]
balanceOf(address _owner) view delegating to getBalance
attacker-controlled caller address used as owner, spender and source of transfers
initialSupply * 10 ** uint256(decimals) computed without SafeMath, unchecked multiplication
balances[msg.sender].sub(_value) and balances[_to].add(_value) state mutations in transfer
balance and allowance mutations in transferFrom after three require checks
allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value unconditional overwrite enabling allowance front-running race
allowed[msg.sender][_spender].add(_addedValue) allowance increment wrapped in SafeMath.add
allowance reset to 0 or reduced by oldValue.sub(_subtractedValue) in decreaseApproval
constructor parameter initialSupply
transfer destination address parameter _to
transfer amount parameter _value
transferFrom source address parameter _from
transferFrom destination address parameter _to
transferFrom amount parameter _value
approve spender address parameter _spender
approve allowance amount parameter _value
allowance owner address parameter _owner
allowance spender address parameter _spender
increaseApproval spender address parameter _spender
increaseApproval increment parameter _addedValue
decreaseApproval spender address parameter _spender
decreaseApproval decrement parameter _subtractedValue
local variable oldValue caching allowed[msg.sender][_spender] in decreaseApproval
getBalance address parameter _a
balanceOf owner address parameter _owner

edges.reason: msg.sender receives the entire initial supply: balances[msg.sender] = totalSupply
msg.sender is the debited account in transfer
msg.sender is the spender key used in allowed[_from][msg.sender]
msg.sender owns the allowance entry written by approve
msg.sender is the allowance owner in increaseApproval
msg.sender is the allowance owner in decreaseApproval
initialSupply parameter seeds the totalSupply computation
initialSupply is an untrusted constructor argument multiplied without SafeMath
decimals is used as the exponent 10 ** uint256(decimals) in the unchecked multiplication
constructor body executes the unchecked multiplication to set the supply
totalSupply is assigned the result of the unchecked multiplication
constructor writes balances[msg.sender] = totalSupply
_to is the credited destination in transfer
_value is the transfer amount compared against the sender balance
transfer body performs the balance update operations
_value flows into sub/add balance mutations
_to is the key whose balance is incremented
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping
balance update operation mutates the balances mapping
_from is the debited account in transferFrom
_to is the credited account in transferFrom
_value is checked against balance and allowance in transferFrom
transferFrom body executes the balance and allowance state mutations
_value flows into balance and allowance subtractions
transferFrom authorizes via allowed[_from][msg.sender] and then decrements it
transferFrom mutates the balances mapping
state update operation writes balances[_from] and balances[_to]
state update operation decrements allowed[_from][msg.sender]
_spender is the allowance key in approve
_value becomes the new allowance value
approve body unconditionally overwrites the allowance entry
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender]
overwrite operation writes the allowed mapping without checking the previous allowance
_value is stored as the overwritten allowance
_owner selects the allowance owner in the view
_spender selects the allowance spender in the view
allowance reads allowed[_owner][_spender]
_spender is the allowance key in increaseApproval
_addedValue is the increment applied to the allowance
increaseApproval body performs the allowance addition operation
addition operation reads and writes the allowed mapping
_addedValue flows into SafeMath.add on the current allowance
increaseApproval mutates allowed[msg.sender][_spender]
_spender is the allowance key in decreaseApproval
_subtractedValue is the decrement applied to the allowance
decreaseApproval body computes the new allowance via branching arithmetic
decreaseApproval caches the current allowance in local oldValue
oldValue is compared with _subtractedValue and then subtracted
decreaseApproval writes the recomputed allowance into allowed
_subtractedValue drives the allowance subtraction or reset to zero
decreaseApproval mutates allowed[msg.sender][_spender]
_a is the address whose balance is read by getBalance
getBalance reads balances[_a]
_owner is forwarded to getBalance by balanceOf
balanceOf calls the internal getBalance helper
